verdict.rationale: There is no documented export or dump feature. Leaving is still plausible: the engine is Apache 2.0 open source, all deployment options (local, embedded, Cloud) share the same queries and tooling, and read queries over the HTTP API return JSON, so data could in principle be pulled out manually. Missing for 10: a documented bulk export/backup tool, export to open formats (e.g. CSV/JSON/Parquet/GraphML), a Cloud-to-self-host migration guide, and hands-on corroboration of a full data exit.
